title: American Artist’s Plein Air Painting Issue
content: Spring is here. Get out your paints!American Artist’s new special issue featuring on plein-air painting has just arrived on the newsstands.The emphasis is on landscape painting from observation. There are articles about Scott Christensen, Clyde Aspevig, Chris Blossom, Clark Hulings, and others.They asked me to adapt material from theColor and Lightbook for an article about sources of light, so I covered direct sunlight, overcast light, window light, candlelight, incandescent, fluorescent, and streetlight.---------American Artist’s Plein Air Painting Issue
